verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes several AMD product-page spec bullets (cTDP, NVMe, displays, OS support) but none state memory type, capacity ceiling, or bandwidth from AMD itself; the only concrete bandwidth/capacity figures (quad-channel DDR5-8000, 128GB unified memory) come from community HN comments, not vendor documentation. Missing for 10: vendor-published memory type/spec, vendor-stated capacity ceiling, vendor-stated or derivable bandwidth number.
